content: As of my last update, the tallest building in the world is the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It stands at a height of approximately 828 meters (2,717 feet) and was officially opened in 2010. The Burj Khalifa holds several records, including the tallest free-standing structure, and has become a symbol of Dubai's rapid growth in the 21st century.
